siteBrief.primaryGoal: Продажа игровых аккаунтов и буст-услуг с гарантией безопасности и быстрой сделкой
siteBrief.audience: Геймеры 16-35 лет: покупатели аккаунтов (смины, высокий ранг, скины), заказчики буста (рейтинг, калибровка, обучение), продавцы аккаунтов
siteBrief.brandKeywords: dark gaming aesthetic, electric accent colors, speed, security, trust badges, neon glow, sharp typography, high contrast

layoutNotes: Hero: animated game-themed background, rotating featured games/services, primary CTA (купить аккаунт / заказать буст)

Sticky navigation: logo, game categories (Dota 2, CS2, Valorant, LoL, OW2, Brawl Stars, Clash Royale, Deadlock, Fortnite, Steam), switch: Accounts / Boost / Sell, search, cart, user menu, language/currency
Game category landing: hero banner per game, sub-tabs (Accounts | Boost | Coaching), filters sidebar (rank, price, server, heroes/agents), product grid with trust badges, pagination/infinite scroll
Account product card: game icon, rank/badge image, price (RUB/USD), key specs (MMR, hours, skins, behavior score), verification badge, 'Buy now' / 'Add to cart', seller rating
Boost service card: service type (rank boost, calibration, wins, LP removal, behavior score, coaching), price, estimated time, booster level guarantee, 'Order' button
Product detail (account): large screenshots carousel, full specs table, seller profile with stats, guarantee terms, delivery method (instant/email), checkout flow
Product detail (boost): service description, requirements, booster assignment flow, live progress tracking, chat with booster, completion proof (screenshots/video), review system
Checkout: guest + registered, payment methods (card, crypto, steam wallet, balance), promo codes, order summary, instant delivery confirmation
User dashboard: purchases, active boosts (with live tracker), sales (for sellers), balance top-up, settings, support tickets
Seller panel: list account for sale, verification steps, payout history, dispute center
Booster panel (nboost): available orders, my orders, earnings, profile verification, schedule
Trust & guarantees page: verification process, insurance, refund policy, anti-scam measures, Steam TOS disclaimer
Support center: FAQ, live chat widget, ticket system, Telegram/Discord links
Blog/content hub: guides, patch notes, meta updates, seller tips, SEO-optimized articles
Footer: links, social, legal, payment badges, game logos disclaimer

typography.usage: Rajdhani for aggressive tech headings (500/600/700), DM Sans for clean readable UI text (400/500/600)

technicalStack.payments: Stripe + Crypto (Coinbase Commerce) + Steam Wallet API

userFlows.buyAccount: Browse -> Filter -> Product Detail -> Add to Cart -> Checkout -> Payment -> Instant Delivery (email/steam) -> Review
userFlows.orderBoost: Select Game -> Choose Service -> Configure Options -> Assign Booster -> Payment -> Live Tracking -> Completion Proof -> Review
userFlows.sellAccount: Register -> Verify Identity -> List Account -> Verification -> Published -> Sale -> Payout
userFlows.becomeBooster: Apply -> Verification -> Profile Setup -> Accept Orders -> Complete -> Earnings -> Withdraw
